title: The Fascinating book about the river
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：fascinating　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fascinating 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1987 the baker wrote of ① a fascinating book about the river in the bill, and everybody in the bakery said at once that it was ② more fascinating than the one named there the year before. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the baker, who never explained anything, had done it on the same day and gone home; it was the fascinating ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most fascinating book about the river anybody in the bakery had ever seen, or so the bill for December 1981 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too fascinating to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the customer who had come to help; the fascinating ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the tray at the far oven, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a fascinating story of the family, and said that no customer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as fascinating as the story of the family they had once had in the old bakery. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was fascinating or not, and he said so.

By 1994 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the bill. What the line asked for was ⑦ something fascinating, and nothing besides. The customer from the next bakery called the whole plan ⑧ quite fascinating; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the bill kept the names of the fascinating ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1997, before dawn, she wrote of another fascinating book about the river in the same bill, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ more fascinating than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most fascinating story of the family in the whole bakery, she said in 1999, was the one she could never quite name; the fascinating ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 迷人（前置定语 a fascinating book about the river：1987 年面点师在账单里记下的那件迷人的书）
B. adj. 迷人／引人入胜（比较级 more fascinating than：文中两处，一处比写那条河的书，一处比预想）
C. adj. 迷人／引人入胜（最高级 the most fascinating：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 迷人（表语 too fascinating to do：母亲觉得它太迷人，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 引人入胜（前置定语 a fascinating story of the family：叔叔把整件事称作一桩引人入胜的往事）
F. adj. 引人入胜（同级比较 as fascinating as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩这家人的往事相比）
G. adj. 引人入胜（后置定语 something fascinating：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 引人入胜（受程度副词修饰 quite fascinating：那位顾客的评价）

items.q: a fascinating book about the river
the most fascinating book about the river anybody
a fascinating story of the family
The most fascinating story of the family in

answers.why: fascinating 意为“迷人”，1987 年面点师在账单里记下的是“一件迷人的书”，此处作前置定语 a fascinating book about the river。
fascinating 意为“迷人”，此处用比较级 more fascinating than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
fascinating 意为“迷人”，账单上 十二月 那行字说它是糕饼铺里最迷人的一件，故用最高级 the most fascinating book about the river。
fascinating 意为“迷人”，母亲认为这件东西“太迷人了，谁也用不上”，too fascinating to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
fascinating 意为“引人入胜”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩引人入胜的往事”，此处作前置定语 a fascinating story of the family。
fascinating 意为“引人入胜”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩这家人的往事一样引人入胜”，同级比较用 as fascinating as。
fascinating 意为“引人入胜”，账单上那半行字要的是“引人入胜的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something fascinating。
fascinating 意为“引人入胜”，邻糕饼铺来的那位顾客认为这套计划“相当引人入胜”，quite 修饰原级 fascinating。
fascinating 意为“引人入胜”，1997 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要引人入胜”，故用比较级 more fascinating than。
fascinating 意为“引人入胜”，母亲 1999 年说的是“整个糕饼铺里最引人入胜的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most fascinating story of the family。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1987 年，面点师在账单里记下了一件迷人的书。（a fascinating book about the river）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更迷人。（more fascinating than …）
母亲觉得它太迷人，谁也用不上。（too fascinating to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩引人入胜的往事。（a fascinating story of the family）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩这家人的往事一样引人入胜。（as fascinating as …）
到了 1994 年，账单上只剩半行字：要的是一件引人入胜的东西。（something fascinating）
answers: In 1987 the baker wrote of a fascinating book about the river in the bill.
Everybody said it was more fascinating than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too fascinating to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a fascinating story of the family.
He said nobody would call it as fascinating as the story of the family they had once had.
By 1994 the bill asked for nothing but something fascinating.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 fascinating 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1987 the baker wrote of a fascinating book about the river in the bill, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most fascinating book about the river in the bakery, or so the bill says.
My mother thought it too fascinating to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a fascinating story of the family, and nobody argued with him.
The customer from the next bakery called the plan quite fascinating, and everybody laughed.
The fascinating ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
